description: This file contains helper functions for managing Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) policies and user profiles in Mattermost, including creating users with custom attributes, enabling/disabling ABAC, navigating to ABAC pages, creating/editing/deleting policies, running sync jobs, and verifying user memberships in channels.

methods.name: createUserWithAttributes
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified custom profile attributes, mapping attribute names to field IDs and setting their values.

methods.name: enableABAC
methods.description: Enables Attribute-Based Access Control in the system console via Playwright automation.

methods.name: disableABAC
methods.description: Disables Attribute-Based Access Control in the system console via Playwright automation.

methods.name: navigateToABACPage
methods.description: Navigates to the ABAC configuration page in the system console.

methods.name: createBasicPolicy
methods.description: Creates a new ABAC policy in basic mode using table editor inputs.

methods.name: createAdvancedPolicy
methods.description: Creates a new ABAC policy in advanced mode using CEL expressions.

methods.name: editPolicy
methods.description: Opens the edit dialog for a specified policy.

methods.name: deletePolicy
methods.description: Deletes a specified policy, confirming if necessary.

methods.name: runSyncJob
methods.description: Triggers a sync job for ABAC and optionally waits for its completion.

methods.name: verifyUserInChannel
methods.description: Checks if a user is a member of a specific channel.

methods.name: verifyUserNotInChannel
methods.description: Checks if a user is not a member of a specific channel.

methods.name: updateUserAttributes
methods.description: Updates a user's custom profile attributes by mapping attribute names to field IDs and setting values.
